page.content:
Yemeni port that named mocha coffee and a later chocolate drink.

How Mocha connects

  • Location: Yemen — Mocha is the Yemeni port that named mocha coffee.
  • Item: Coffea arabica — Historic mocha shipments were Yemeni arabica through Al-Mukha.

What is Mocha?

Al-Mukha (Mocha) shipped Yemeni beans to Cairo and Europe. The port's name stuck to dry-processed Yemeni lots and, later, to coffee-plus-chocolate.

Key threads lead to Yemen and Coffea arabica.
